'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[2025 Shabelle offensive]]
***[[2025 Jaalle Siyaad military academy bombing]]
****Several people are killed and injured in a [[suicide bombing]] targeting the [[14th October Brigade]] of the [[Somali Armed Forces]] at a military academy in [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]]. [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] claims responsibility for the attack. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/blast-hits-military-base-somali-capital-witness-al-shabaab-group-say-2025-07-09/ (Reuters)] [https://hiiraan.com/news4/2025/July/202140/suicide_bomber_targets_somali_military_academy_in_mogadishu_casualties_reported.aspx (Hiiraan Online)] [https://somaliguardian.com/news/somalia-news/suicide-bomber-targets-somali-military-academy-during-visit-by-western-officials/ (''Somali Guardian'')]
***At least seven [[Kenya Police|Kenyan police officers]] are injured after an al-Shabaab [[Improvised explosive device|roadside bomb]] strikes their [[Nissan Patrol|patrol truck]] on a highway east of [[Mandera]] in [[Kenya]], near the border with Somalia. [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/July/202142/al_shabab_roadside_bomb_wounds_7_kenyan_police_officers_near_mandera.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[Houthi attacks on commercial vessels]]
***[[Attacks on the Eternity C|Attacks on the ''Eternity C'']]
****The ''Eternity C'', a [[Liberia]]n-flagged ship, sinks in the [[Red Sea]] after being attacked by the [[Houthis]] on Monday. At least four people are killed, seven others are rescued and fourteen are reported missing. A rescue operation is underway. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/jul/09/rescuers-search-for-crew-of-cargo-ship-eternity-c-that-sank-after-being-attacked-in-red-sea (''The Guardian'')] [https://nos.nl/artikel/2574293-schip-op-rode-zee-gezonken-na-aanval-door-houthi-s-bemanning-te-water (NOS)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] launch 728 [[HESA_Shahed_136#Geran-2|Geran-2]] drones at [[Ukraine]] overnight in the largest single [[drone attack]] of the war to date. [https://www.newsweek.com/russia-ukraine-war-drone-putin-trump-2096445 (''Newsweek'')]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**A donkey packed with explosives blasts near a military outpost in Las Cruces sector, Valdivia, Antioquia Department, killing one soldier and injuring two. Authorities blamed the ELN of being behind the attack. [https://caracol.com.co/2025/07/09/ataque-con-mula-bomba-deja-un-soldado-muerto-y-varios-heridos-en-valdivia/ (Radio Caracol)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Tariffs in the second Trump administration]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces a 50% [[tariff]] on most imports into the [[United States]] from [[Brazil]] starting August 1, in a letter addressed to [[President of Brazil|Brazilian president]] [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]] and citing [[Ineligibility of Jair Bolsonaro|the trial]] of former Brazilian president [[Jair Bolsonaro]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/eu-seeks-trade-deal-with-trump-this-month-new-tariff-notices-due-2025-07-09/ (Reuters)]
**President Trump also announces a new set of tariff rates on imports from [[Algeria]], [[Brunei]], [[Iraq]], [[Libya]], [[Moldova]], the [[Philippines]], and [[Sri Lanka]], assigning country-specific duties ranging from 20 to 30% following the expiration of a 90-day negotiation period. [https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2025/7/9/trump-issues-new-tariffs-for-six-countries-including-iraq-and-the-philippines (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Guatemala earthquakes]]
**At least six people die when a {{M|w|5.7}} [[earthquake]] strikes [[Guatemala]] and causes widespread damage. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/International/wireStory/dozens-earthquakes-aftershocks-cause-deaths-guatemala-123600934 (ABC News)]
*At least thirteen people are killed and nine others are injured after a section of the [[Gambhira Bridge]] in [[Gujarat]], [[India]], partially collapses during morning [[rush hour]]. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/watch-rescue-teams-try-to-pull-out-truck-after-gujarat-bridge-collapse-10-dead-several-injured/articleshow/122342737.cms (''The Times of India'')] [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/gujarat-bridge-collapse-crumbling-gambhira-bridge-was-40-years-old-gave-way-in-peak-traffic-hours-mahisagar-river-cars-deaths-news-vadodara-8847480 (NDTV)]

'''International relations'''
*[[United States and the United Nations]]
**The United States issues sanctions against [[Francesca Albanese]], the [[United Nations]] [[UN Special Rapporteur on the occupied Palestinian territories|special rapporteur]] for human rights in the [[Israeli-occupied territories|occupied Palestinian territories]]. [https://www.npr.org/2025/07/10/g-s1-76915/u-s-sanctions-united-nations-investigator-abuses-gaza (NPR)]
*The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates (Syria)|Syrian minister of foreign affairs]] [[Asaad al-Shaibani]] announces the country's readmission to the [[Union for the Mediterranean]] after 13 years of its suspension. [https://www.arknews.net/en/node/60335 (ARK News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 South Korean martial law crisis]]
**The [[High courts of South Korea|Seoul Central District Court]] issues an [[Arrest of Yoon Suk Yeol|arrest warrant]] for former [[South Korea]]n [[President of South Korea|president]] [[Yoon Suk Yeol]] over five key charges related to his short-lived [[martial law]] declaration on December 3, 2024, placing him in custody for the first time since March due to concerns of [[evidence tampering]]. [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20250709006551315 (Yonhap)]
*[[Censorship in Turkey]]
**[[Turkey]] partially bans certain contents from [[Twitter|X]] (formerly Twitter)'s [[Artificial intelligence|AI]] chatbot [[Grok (chatbot)|Grok]] amid a criminal probe over insults to [[President of Turkey|Turkish president]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] and the country's founder [[Mustafa Kemal Atatürk]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/turkey-blocks-xs-grok-chatbot-alleged-insults-erdogan-2025-07-09/ (Reuters)]
